main.description: A space's profile and join policy — one record per space. Written to the space's repo.

avatar.description: The space's avatar reference, as the space holds it: a blob ref string (`atblob://<did>/<cid>`) or a plain URL.

allowPublicJoin.description: Whether anyone who finds the space may join. Absent reads as open.

allowMemberInvites.description: Whether a member may invite another account. Absent reads as allowed.

suggestToOthers.description: Whether the space is suggested to people outside it. Absent reads as suggested.
